# Standard library reference

<!-- Generated by `tys docs` from the standard library declarations. Do not edit by hand:
     run `./gradlew -q :tachyon-cli:run --args=docs > docs/language/reference.md`. -->

Everything below is checked by the compiler: using a name that is not listed here, or
with the wrong types, is a compile error with a suggestion.

* [Events](#events)
* [Global functions and properties](#global-functions-and-properties)
* [Types](#types)

## Events

A handler is written `event <name> { ... }`. The variables below are available in the
handler; `event` is the event object itself.

### `player.join`

A player joined the server.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player who joined. |

`event` is a [`PlayerJoinEvent`](#playerjoinevent).

```tys
event player.join {
    player.send("<green>Welcome {player.name}!")
}
```

### `player.quit`

A player left the server.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player who left. |

`event` is a [`PlayerQuitEvent`](#playerquitevent).

### `player.death`

A player died.

Cancelling it keeps the player alive: the server revives them instead (with full health).

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `victim` | `Player` | The player who died. |
| `killer` | `Player?` | The player who killed them, if any. |

`event` is a [`PlayerDeathEvent`](#playerdeathevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `player.chat`

A player sent a chat message.

Chat is handled off the main thread. Treat the message as untrusted text.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player who sent the message. |
| `message` | `string` | The plain text of the message. |

`event` is a [`PlayerChatEvent`](#playerchatevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `player.move`

A player moved or turned.

Fires very often (many times per second per player). Keep handlers short.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The moving player. |
| `from` | `Location` | Where the player was. |
| `to` | `Location` | Where the player is moving to. |

`event` is a [`PlayerMoveEvent`](#playermoveevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `block.break`

A player is breaking a block.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player breaking the block. |
| `block` | `Block` | The block being broken. |

`event` is a [`BlockBreakEvent`](#blockbreakevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `entity.damage`

An entity is about to take damage. Change event.damage to modify it.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | `Entity` | The damaged entity. |
| `cause` | `string` | Damage cause, e.g. 'fall' or 'entity_attack'. |

`event` is a [`EntityDamageEvent`](#entitydamageevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `player.respawn`

A player respawns after dying.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The respawning player. |

`event` is a [`PlayerRespawnEvent`](#playerrespawnevent).

```tys
event player.respawn {
    event.respawnLocation = server.defaultWorld.spawnLocation
}
```

### `player.teleport`

A player teleports (command, ender pearl, portal, plugin, ...).

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The teleporting player. |
| `from` | `Location` | Where the player was. |
| `to` | `Location` | Where the player goes. |
| `cause` | `TeleportCause` | Why the player teleports. |

`event` is a [`PlayerTeleportEvent`](#playerteleportevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `player.command`

A player runs a command (before the command itself runs).

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player. |
| `command` | `string` | The command line without the leading /. |
| `label` | `string` | The command name in lower case, e.g. 'spawn'. |

`event` is a [`PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent`](#playercommandpreprocessevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

```tys
event player.command {
    if label == "pl" || label == "plugins" {
        event.cancel()
        player.send("<red>No peeking!")
    }
}
```

### `player.interact`

A player clicks: at the air, at a block, or steps on a pressure plate.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player. |
| `action` | `Action` | What the player did. |
| `block` | `Block?` | The clicked block, or null when clicking the air. |
| `face` | `BlockFace` | The clicked side of the block. |
| `item` | `ItemStack?` | The item in the hand used, or null. |
| `hand` | `EquipmentSlot?` | The hand used (HAND or OFF_HAND), or null. |

`event` is a [`PlayerInteractEvent`](#playerinteractevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

```tys
event player.interact {
    if event.rightClick && event.mainHand && item?.type == Material.BLAZE_ROD {
        player.launchProjectile(EntityType.FIREBALL)
    }
}
```

### `player.interactEntity`

A player right-clicks an entity.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player. |
| `entity` | `Entity` | The clicked entity. |
| `hand` | `EquipmentSlot` | The hand used. |

`event` is a [`PlayerInteractEntityEvent`](#playerinteractentityevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `player.toggleSneak`

A player starts or stops sneaking.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player. |
| `sneaking` | `bool` | Whether the player starts sneaking. |

`event` is a [`PlayerToggleSneakEvent`](#playertogglesneakevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `player.toggleSprint`

A player starts or stops sprinting.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player. |
| `sprinting` | `bool` | Whether the player starts sprinting. |

`event` is a [`PlayerToggleSprintEvent`](#playertogglesprintevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `player.toggleFlight`

A player starts or stops flying.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The player. |
| `flying` | `bool` | Whether the player starts flying. |

`event` is a [`PlayerToggleFlightEvent`](#playertoggleflightevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

```tys
// double jump
event player.toggleFlight {
    if player.gameMode == GameMode.SURVIVAL {
        event.cancel()
        player.allowFlight = false
        player.velocity = player.direction.multiply(1.2).add(Vector(0, 0.8, 0))
    }
}
```

### `player.preLogin`

A player is connecting (before they are in the world; runs off the server thread).

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The player's name. |
| `uuid` | `UUID` | The player's UUID. |
| `address` | `string` | The player's IP address. |

`event` is a [`AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent`](#asyncplayerpreloginevent).

```tys
event player.preLogin {
    if name.startsWithIgnoreCase("bot") {
        event.disallow("<red>Bots are not welcome")
    }
}
```

### `player.inventoryClick`

|---|---|---|

| `rawSlot` | `int` | The slot number in the whole view (top inventory first). |
| `click` | `ClickType` | How the slot was clicked. |
| `item` | `ItemStack?` | The item in the clicked slot, or null. |
| `cursor` | `ItemStack?` | The item on the cursor, or null. |
| `inventory` | `Inventory?` | The clicked inventory (null when clicking outside). |
| `topInventory` | `Inventory` | The inventory at the top of the view. |

`event` is a [`InventoryClickEvent`](#inventoryclickevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

### `entity.death`

A living entity (mob or player) dies.

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | `LivingEntity` | The entity that died. |
| `killer` | `Player?` | The player who killed it, or null. |

`event` is a [`EntityDeathEvent`](#entitydeathevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

```tys
event entity.death {
    if killer != null && entity is Monster {
        killer.giveExp(5)
    }
}
```

### `entity.damageByEntity`

An entity is hurt by another entity (a hit, an arrow, an explosion, ...).

| Variable | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `entity` | `Entity` | The hurt entity. |
| `damager` | `Entity` | What hit it (an arrow for shots). |
| `attacker` | `Entity?` | Who is responsible: the damager, or the shooter of a projectile. |
| `cause` | `DamageCause` | The kind of damage. |

`event` is a [`EntityDamageByEntityEvent`](#entitydamagebyentityevent); the event can be cancelled with `event.cancel()`.

```tys
event entity.damageByEntity {
    if entity is Player && attacker is Player {
        event.cancel()   // no PvP
    }
}
```

## Global functions and properties

### Top level

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BossBar(title: Component)` | `BossBar` | A full white boss bar. It belongs to the script: reloading the script hides it. |
| `BossBar(title: Component, progress: double, color: BarColor, style: BarStyle)` | `BossBar` | A boss bar; progress goes from 0 (empty) to 1 (full). |
| `Color(red: int, green: int, blue: int)` | `Color` | A color from red, green and blue (0 to 255). |
| `Database(name: string)` | `Database` | A database configured in config.yml (databases: ...). |
| `Inventory(rows: int, title: Component)` | `Inventory` | A new chest inventory with 1 to 6 rows (it belongs to no block). |
| `Inventory(type: InventoryType, title: Component)` | `Inventory` | A new inventory of a kind (hopper, dispenser, ...). |
| `ItemStack(material: Material)` | `ItemStack` | One item of a material. |
| `ItemStack(material: Material, amount: int)` | `ItemStack` | Items of a material. |
| `ItemStack(material: Material, amount: int, name: Component)` | `ItemStack` | Items with a custom name. |
| `ItemStack(material: Material, amount: int, name: Component, lore: List<Component>)` | `ItemStack` | Items with a custom name and lore lines. |
| `Location(world: World, x: double, y: double, z: double)` | `Location` | A location. |
| `Location(world: World, x: double, y: double, z: double, yaw: double, pitch: double)` | `Location` | A location with a rotation. |
| `Menu(rows: int, title: Component)` | `Menu` | A chest menu with 1 to 6 rows. Clicks are cancelled unless allowTaking is set. |
| `Menu(type: InventoryType, title: Component)` | `Menu` | A menu of another shape (hopper, dispenser, ...). |
| `PotionEffect(type: PotionEffectType, duration: Duration, level: int)` | `PotionEffect` | A potion effect; level 1 is the normal strength, a negative duration lasts forever. |
| `PotionEffect(type: PotionEffectType, duration: Duration, level: int, ambient: bool, particles: bool)` | `PotionEffect` | A potion effect with beacon-like (ambient) look and optional particles. |
| `Sidebar(title: Component)` | `Sidebar` | A scoreboard sidebar (up to 15 lines). It belongs to the script: reloading the script removes it. |
| `Vector(x: double, y: double, z: double)` | `Vector` | A vector. |
| `broadcast(message: Component)` | `void` | Sends a message to every online player and the console. |
| `broadcast(message: Component, permission: string)` | `void` | Sends a message to every player with a permission (and the console). |
| `location(world: World, x: double, y: double, z: double)` | `Location` | Creates a location. |
| `log(message: string)` | `void` | Writes a message to the server log. |
| `log(message: any?)` | `void` | Writes a value to the server log. |

**`BossBar(title: Component, progress: double, color: BarColor, style: BarStyle)`**

```tys-body
let bar = BossBar("<red>Boss", 1.0, BarColor.RED, BarStyle.NOTCHED_10)
bar.show(player)
```

**`Database(name: string)`** — SQLite databases are files; MySQL and MariaDB databases are servers. The server owner configures them, so scripts never contain passwords.

```tys-body
let shop = Database("main")
```

**`ItemStack(material: Material)`**

```tys-body
player.give(ItemStack(Material.DIAMOND_SWORD))
```

**`ItemStack(material: Material, amount: int, name: Component)`**

```tys-body
let sword = ItemStack(Material.DIAMOND_SWORD, 1, "<gold>Excalibur")
```

**`ItemStack(material: Material, amount: int, name: Component, lore: List<Component>)`**

```tys-body
let key = ItemStack(Material.TRIPWIRE_HOOK, 1, "<yellow>Crate key", ["<gray>Right-click a crate", "<gray>to open it"])
```

**`Location(world: World, x: double, y: double, z: double)`**

```tys-body
let spawn = Location(player.world, 0.5, 64, 0.5)
```

**`Menu(rows: int, title: Component)`** — A menu belongs to the script that created it: reloading the script closes it. Slots count from 0 (top left) to rows * 9 - 1.

```tys-body
let menu = Menu(3, "<dark_green>Shop")
menu.set(13, ItemStack(Material.BREAD, 16), click => {
    click.player.give(ItemStack(Material.BREAD, 16))
    click.close()
})
menu.open(player)
```

**`Sidebar(title: Component)`**

```tys-body
let board = Sidebar("<gold><bold>My Server")
board.lines = ["<gray>Level: <yellow>{player.level}", "", "<gray>play.example.com"]
board.show(player)
```

**`economy.balance(player: OfflinePlayer)`**

```tys-body
player.send("Balance: {economy.format(economy.balance(player))}")
```

**`economy.withdraw(player: OfflinePlayer, amount: double)`**

```tys-body
if economy.withdraw(player, 100) {
    player.give(ItemStack(Material.DIAMOND))
} else {
    player.send("<red>You need 100 coins.")
}
```

### `files`

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `files.append(path: string, line: string)` | `void` | Adds a line at the end of a file. |
| `files.delete(path: string)` | `bool` | Deletes a file; false if it did not exist. |
| `files.exists(path: string)` | `bool` | Whether a file exists. |
| `files.lines(path: string)` | `List<string>` | The lines of a file (empty if it does not exist). |
| `files.list(folder: string)` | `List<string>` | The names of the files in a folder. |
| `files.read(path: string)` | `string?` | The text of a file, or null if it does not exist. |
| `files.write(path: string, text: string)` | `void` | Replaces the text of a file (creating folders as needed). |

**`files.append(path: string, line: string)`**

```tys-body
let date = time.format(time.now, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")
files.append("logs/trades.log", "{date} {player.name} bought bread")
```

### `format`

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `format.bytes(value: long)` | `string` | A size in bytes: '512 B', '1.5 MB'. |
| `format.compact(value: double)` | `string` | A short form for large numbers: 1.5K, 2.3M, 7B. |
| `format.decimal(value: double, decimals: int)` | `string` | A number with exactly some decimals and no separators: format.decimal(2.5, 2) = '2.50'. |
| `format.duration(duration: Duration)` | `string` | A duration in words: '1 hour, 30 minutes'. |
| `format.money(value: double)` | `string` | An amount with two decimals and separators, e.g. 1,234.50. |
| `format.number(value: long)` | `string` | A whole number with thousands separators, e.g. 1,234,567. |

| `format.ordinal(value: int)` | `string` | An English ordinal: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. |
| `format.percent(value: double)` | `string` | A fraction as a percentage: format.percent(0.256) = '25.6%'. |
| `format.plural(count: long, singular: string, plural: string)` | `string` | '1 apple' or '3 apples'. |
| `format.roman(value: int)` | `string` | A number in Roman numerals (1 to 3999), e.g. 14 = 'XIV'. |


**`time.format(instant: Instant, pattern: string)`** — Patterns use letters like yyyy (year), MM (month), dd (day), HH (hour), mm (minute), ss (second), EEEE (weekday name).

```tys-body
let clock = time.format(time.now, "HH:mm")
player.send("It is {clock}")
```

**`time.nanos`**

```tys-body
let start = time.nanos
// ... work ...
log("took {(time.nanos - start) / 1000} µs")
```

**`time.now`**

```tys
persistent var lastRestart: Instant = time.now
```

**`time.parse(text: string, pattern: string)`**

```tys-body
let deadline = time.parse("2026-12-31 23:59", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")
```

**`time.since(instant: Instant)`**

```tys
playerdata var lastReward: Instant? = null

event player.join {
    let last = player.lastReward
    if last == null || time.since(last) >= 1 day {
        player.lastReward = time.now
        player.give(ItemStack(Material.DIAMOND))
    }
}
```

## Types

Built into the language: `int`, `long`, `float`, `double`, `bool`, `Duration`, `List<T>`,
and `T?` (a `T` or `null`); see [Types](types.md).

### any

Any non-null value.

### string

Immutable text.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `capitalize()` | `string` | The text with its first letter in upper case. |
| `charAt(index: int)` | `string` | The character at an index, as text. |
| `chars()` | `List<string>` | Every character, as a list of one-character texts. |
| `contains(text: string)` | `bool` | Whether the text contains another text. |
| `containsIgnoreCase(text: string)` | `bool` | Whether the text contains another, ignoring upper/lower case. |
| `count(text: string)` | `int` | How many times a text occurs (without overlaps). |
| `endsWith(text: string)` | `bool` | Whether the text ends with a suffix. |
| `equalsIgnoreCase(other: string)` | `bool` | Whether two texts are equal, ignoring upper/lower case. |
| `find(regex: string)` | `string?` | The first part matching a regular expression, or null. |
| `findAll(regex: string)` | `List<string>` | Every part matching a regular expression. |
| `indexOf(text: string)` | `int` | Index of the first occurrence, or -1. |
| `isBlank` | `bool` | Whether the text is empty or only spaces. |
| `isEmpty` | `bool` | Whether the text is empty. |
| `lastIndexOf(text: string)` | `int` | Index of the last occurrence, or -1. |
| `length` | `int` | Number of characters. |
| `lines()` | `List<string>` | The lines of the text. |
| `lower()` | `string` | Lower-case copy. |
| `matches(regex: string)` | `bool` | Whether the whole text matches a regular expression. |
| `padLeft(length: int)` | `string` | Adds spaces in front up to a length. |
| `padLeft(length: int, fill: string)` | `string` | Adds a fill character in front up to a length: "7".padLeft(3, "0") = "007". |
| `padRight(length: int)` | `string` | Adds spaces after up to a length. |
| `padRight(length: int, fill: string)` | `string` | Adds a fill character after up to a length. |
| `repeat(count: int)` | `string` | The text repeated: "ab".repeat(3) = "ababab". |
| `replace(target: string, replacement: string)` | `string` | Copy with every occurrence of target replaced. |
| `replaceAll(regex: string, replacement: string)` | `string` | Replaces every match of a regular expression ($1 refers to a group). |
| `replaceFirst(regex: string, replacement: string)` | `string` | Replaces the first match of a regular expression. |
| `reversed()` | `string` | The text backwards. |
| `split(separator: string)` | `List<string>` | The parts between the separators (the separator is plain text, not a pattern). |
| `split(separator: string, limit: int)` | `List<string>` | At most 'limit' parts; the last part holds the rest. |
| `startsWith(text: string)` | `bool` | Whether the text starts with a prefix. |
| `startsWithIgnoreCase(prefix: string)` | `bool` | Whether the text starts with a prefix, ignoring case. |
| `substring(start: int)` | `string` | The text from an index to the end. |
| `substring(start: int, end: int)` | `string` | The text from start (included) to end (excluded). |
| `titleCase()` | `string` | Every word capitalized, underscores as spaces: "diamond_sword" -> "Diamond Sword". |
| `toBool()` | `bool?` | true for "true"/"yes"/"on", false for "false"/"no"/"off", otherwise null. |
| `toDouble()` | `double?` | The text as a number, or null if it is not one. |
| `toInt()` | `int?` | The text as a whole number, or null if it is not one. |
| `toLong()` | `long?` | The text as a long, or null if it is not a whole number. |
| `toUUID()` | `UUID?` | The text as a UUID, or null. |
| `trim()` | `string` | Copy without leading and trailing spaces. |
| `truncate(length: int)` | `string` | The text cut to a length, ending with '...' when it was longer. |
| `upper()` | `string` | Upper-case copy. |

**`matches(regex: string)`**

```tys-body
let name = player.name
if name.length < 3 || name.length > 16 || !name.matches("[a-zA-Z0-9_]+") {
    player.send("<red>Invalid name")
}
```

**`split(separator: string)`**

```tys-body
let parts = "a,b,c".split(",")   // ["a", "b", "c"]
```

### Component

Formatted chat text (MiniMessage).

### Error

An error caught with try/catch: its message, kind and script location.

### UUID

A unique identifier.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `toString()` | `string` | The canonical text form of the UUID. |

### CommandSender

Something that can run commands and receive messages: a player or the console.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dispatch(command: string)` | `bool` | Runs a command as this sender (without the leading /); false if it does not exist. |
| `hasPermission(permission: string)` | `bool` | Whether the sender has a permission. |
| `isConsole` | `bool` | Whether the sender is the server console. |
| `name` | `string` | The sender's name (the player name, or CONSOLE). |
| `op` | `bool` | Whether the sender is a server operator. |
| `send(message: Component)` | `void` | Sends a chat message. |

**`send(message: Component)`** — A string argument is MiniMessage text; interpolated values are inserted as plain text.

```tys-body
player.send("<green>Welcome {player.name}!")
```

### World

A loaded world.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `blockAt(x: int, y: int, z: int)` | `Block` | The block at a position. |
| `borderCenter` (read/write) | `Location` | The center of the world border. |
| `borderSize` (read/write) | `double` | The width of the world border in blocks. |
| `chunkAt(x: int, z: int)` | `Chunk` | The chunk at chunk coordinates (loads it if needed). |
| `createExplosion(location: Location, power: double)` | `void` | An explosion (TNT has power 4). |
| `createExplosion(location: Location, power: double, fire: bool, breakBlocks: bool)` | `void` | An explosion that may set fires and break blocks. |
| `difficulty` (read/write) | `Difficulty` | The world's difficulty. |
| `dropItem(location: Location, item: ItemStack)` | `Item` | Drops items at a location. |

| `isDay` | `bool` | Whether it is day (the sun is up). |
| `isNight` | `bool` | Whether it is night. |
| `livingEntities` | `List<LivingEntity>` | Every loaded living entity of the world. |
| `maxHeight` | `int` | The height above the highest block. |
| `minHeight` | `int` | The lowest block height. |
| `name` | `string` | The world's name. |
| `players` | `List<Player>` | A snapshot of the players currently in the world. |
| `pvp` (read/write) | `bool` | Whether players can hurt each other in this world. |
| `removeTag(key: string)` | `void` | Removes a tag from the world. |
| `save()` | `void` | Saves the world to disk. |
| `seaLevel` | `int` | The sea level. |
| `seed` | `long` | The world's seed. |
| `setClearWeather(duration: Duration)` | `void` | Stops rain and thunder for a while. |
| `setGameRule(name: string, value: string)` | `bool` | Changes a game rule; false if the rule or the value is invalid. |
| `setTag(key: string, value: string)` | `void` | Stores a text tag in the world. |
| `spawn(type: EntityType, location: Location)` | `Entity` | Spawns an entity. |
| `spawnLocation` (read/write) | `Location` | The world's spawn point. |
| `storm` (read/write) | `bool` | Whether it rains (or snows). |
| `strikeLightning(location: Location)` | `void` | Strikes lightning that can hurt and burn. |
| `strikeLightningEffect(location: Location)` | `void` | Shows lightning that does no harm. |

| `time` (read/write) | `long` | Time of day in ticks (0 to 24000). |
| `toString()` | `string` | The world's name. |
| `weatherDuration` (read/write) | `Duration` | How long the current weather lasts. |

**`setGameRule(name: string, value: string)`**

```tys-body
player.world.setGameRule("keepInventory", "true")
```

### Location

A position (x, y, z, yaw, pitch) in a world.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `add(x: double, y: double, z: double)` | `Location` | A new location offset by the given amounts. |
| `add(vector: Vector)` | `Location` | A new location moved by a vector. |
| `biome` | `Biome` | The biome at the location. |
| `block` | `Block` | The block at the location. |
| `blockLocation` | `Location` | The corner of the block at this location (whole coordinates). |
| `blockX` | `int` | The x coordinate of the block. |
| `blockY` | `int` | The y coordinate of the block. |
| `blockZ` | `int` | The z coordinate of the block. |
| `blocksInRadius(radius: int)` | `List<Block>` | Blocks within a distance (a sphere; the radius is at most 16). |
| `center` | `Location` | The center of the block at this location. |
| `chunk` | `Chunk` | The chunk of the location (loads it if needed). |
| `createExplosion(power: double)` | `void` | An explosion at the location. |
| `direction` | `Vector` | The direction the rotation points to, as a vector of length 1. |
| `distance(other: Location)` | `double` | Distance to another location in the same world. |
| `distanceSquared(other: Location)` | `double` | The squared distance (faster than distance, for comparisons). |
| `dropItem(item: ItemStack)` | `Item` | Drops items at the location. |
| `forward(distance: double)` | `Location` | A new location moved forward along its direction. |
| `highestBlock` | `Block` | The highest non-air block above or below this location. |
| `isChunkLoaded` | `bool` | Whether the chunk of the location is loaded. |
| `isSafe` | `bool` | Whether a player can stand here: two free blocks and solid ground below. |
| `lightLevel` | `int` | The light level at the location, 0 to 15. |
| `lookAt(target: Location)` | `Location` | A copy turned to face another location. |
| `nearbyEntities(radius: double)` | `List<Entity>` | Entities within a distance of the location. |
| `nearbyPlayers(radius: double)` | `List<Player>` | Players within a distance of the location. |
| `pitch` | `float` | Vertical rotation in degrees. |
| `playSound(sound: Sound)` | `void` | Plays a sound at the location for everyone nearby. |
| `playSound(sound: Sound, volume: double, pitch: double)` | `void` | Plays a sound at the location (pitch 0.5 to 2). |
| `spawn(type: EntityType)` | `Entity` | Spawns an entity at the location. |
| `spawnDust(color: Color, size: double, count: int)` | `void` | Shows colored dust particles. |
| `spawnParticle(particle: Particle, count: int)` | `void` | Shows particles at the location. |
| `spawnParticle(particle: Particle, count: int, offsetX: double, offsetY: double, offsetZ: double, speed: double)` | `void` | Shows particles spread around the location. |
| `spawnText(text: Component)` | `TextDisplay` | A floating text (hologram) at the location. |
| `strikeLightning()` | `void` | Strikes lightning at the location. |
| `subtract(x: double, y: double, z: double)` | `Location` | A new location moved back by some amounts. |
| `subtract(vector: Vector)` | `Location` | A new location moved back by a vector. |
| `toString()` | `string` | Text such as 'world 10.5, 64, -3'. |
| `toVector()` | `Vector` | The coordinates as a vector. |
| `withPitch(pitch: double)` | `Location` | A copy with another pitch. |
| `withWorld(world: World)` | `Location` | A copy in another world. |
| `withX(x: double)` | `Location` | A copy with another x. |
| `withY(y: double)` | `Location` | A copy with another y. |
| `withYaw(yaw: double)` | `Location` | A copy with another yaw. |
| `withZ(z: double)` | `Location` | A copy with another z. |
| `world` | `World?` | The world of the location, or null if it is not loaded. |
| `x` | `double` | The x coordinate. |
| `y` | `double` | The y coordinate. |
| `yaw` | `float` | Horizontal rotation in degrees. |
| `z` | `double` | The z coordinate. |

**`spawn(type: EntityType)`**

```tys-body
let zombie = player.location.spawn(EntityType.ZOMBIE) as Mob
zombie.target = player
```

**`spawnParticle(particle: Particle, count: int)`**

```tys-body
player.location.add(0, 2, 0).spawnParticle(Particle.HEART, 5)
```

**`spawnText(text: Component)`**

```tys-body
let hologram = player.location.add(0, 2, 0).spawnText("<gold>Welcome!")
```

### Entity

Any entity in a world.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `addPassenger(passenger: Entity)` | `void` | Makes another entity ride this one. |
| `addScoreboardTag(tag: string)` | `bool` | Adds a scoreboard tag; false if it was already there. |

| `direction` | `Vector` | The direction the entity looks at, as a vector of length 1. |
| `distance(other: Entity)` | `double` | The distance to another entity; very large if they are in different worlds. |

| `doubleTag(key: string)` | `double?` | A number tag of the entity, or null. |
| `eject()` | `void` | Makes every passenger get off. |

| `fallDistance` (read/write) | `double` | How far the entity has fallen, in blocks. |
| `fireTicks` (read/write) | `int` | Ticks the entity keeps burning (20 ticks = 1 second). |

| `frozen` | `bool` | Whether the entity is fully frozen. |
| `glowing` (read/write) | `bool` | Whether the entity has a glowing outline. |
| `gravity` (read/write) | `bool` | Whether gravity pulls the entity down. |
| `hasScoreboardTag(tag: string)` | `bool` | Whether the entity has a scoreboard tag. |
| `hasTag(key: string)` | `bool` | Whether the entity has a tag. |
| `height` | `double` | The entity's height in blocks. |
| `id` | `int` | The entity's number in this server session (not saved; use uuid to remember entities). |
| `inLava` | `bool` | Whether the entity is in lava. |
| `inWater` | `bool` | Whether the entity is in water. |
| `intTag(key: string)` | `int?` | A whole-number tag of the entity, or null. |
| `invulnerable` (read/write) | `bool` | Whether the entity ignores damage (except from creative players and the void). |
| `leaveVehicle()` | `void` | Gets off the entity's vehicle. |
| `location` | `Location` | A copy of the entity's current location. |
| `name` | `string` | The entity's name. |
| `nearbyEntities(radius: double)` | `List<Entity>` | Entities within a distance (a sphere), excluding this one. |
| `nearbyPlayers(radius: double)` | `List<Player>` | Players within a distance, excluding this entity. |
| `onGround` | `bool` | Whether the entity stands on a block. |
| `passengers` | `List<Entity>` | The entities riding this one. |
| `persistent` (read/write) | `bool` | Whether the entity is saved with its chunk (false: removed when the chunk unloads). |
| `portalCooldown` (read/write) | `int` | Ticks before the entity can use a portal again. |
| `remove()` | `void` | Removes the entity from the world (players cannot be removed; kick them instead). |
| `removePassenger(passenger: Entity)` | `void` | Makes a passenger get off. |
| `removeScoreboardTag(tag: string)` | `bool` | Removes a scoreboard tag; false if it was not there. |
| `removeTag(key: string)` | `void` | Removes a tag from the entity. |
| `scoreboardTags` | `List<string>` | The entity's scoreboard tags (the /tag command). |
| `setRotation(yaw: double, pitch: double)` | `void` | Turns the entity (degrees). |
| `setTag(key: string, value: string)` | `void` | Stores a text tag in the entity (saved with it). |
| `setTag(key: string, value: int)` | `void` | Stores a whole-number tag in the entity. |
| `setTag(key: string, value: double)` | `void` | Stores a number tag in the entity. |
| `silent` (read/write) | `bool` | Whether the entity makes no sounds. |
| `tag(key: string)` | `string?` | A text tag of the entity, or null. |
| `tags` | `List<string>` | The keys of the entity's tags. |
| `teleport(destination: Location)` | `void` | Teleports the entity to a location. |
| `teleport(target: Entity)` | `void` | Teleports the entity to another entity. |
| `ticksLived` | `int` | Ticks since the entity spawned. |
| `toString()` | `string` | The entity's name. |
| `type` | `EntityType` | The kind of entity. |
| `uuid` | `UUID` | The entity's unique id. |
| `valid` | `bool` | Whether the entity still exists (false after it died, despawned or the player left). |
| `vehicle` | `Entity?` | The entity this one rides, or null. |
| `velocity` (read/write) | `Vector` | The current velocity in blocks per tick. |
| `width` | `double` | The entity's width in blocks. |
| `world` | `World` | The world the entity is in. |

**`nearbyEntities(radius: double)`**

```tys-body
for other in player.nearbyEntities(10) {
    if other is Monster {
        other.glowing = true
    }
}
```

**`type`**

```tys
event entity.spawn {
    if entity.type == EntityType.CREEPER {
        event.cancel()
    }
}
```

**`velocity`**

```tys-body
player.velocity = Vector(0, 1.5, 0)   // launch upwards
```

**`addPotionEffect(type: PotionEffectType, duration: Duration, level: int)`**

```tys-body
player.addPotionEffect(PotionEffectType.SPEED, 30 seconds, 2)
```

**`mainHand`**

```tys-body
let tool = player.mainHand
if tool != null && tool.type == Material.DIAMOND_PICKAXE {
    player.send("Nice pickaxe!")

```

**`setAttributeBase(attribute: Attribute, value: double)`**

```tys-body
player.setAttributeBase(Attribute.MOVEMENT_SPEED, 0.15)
```

### OfflinePlayer

A player who may be offline: everything known about a player without them being online.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ban(reason: string)` | `void` | Bans the player (and kicks them if online). |

| `online` | `bool` | Whether the player is online now. |

**`ban(reason: string, duration: Duration)`**

```tys-body
target.ban("Griefing", 3 days)
```

| `walkSpeed` (read/write) | `double` | Walking speed, from -1 to 1 (0.2 is normal). |

```tys-body
}
```

### Sql

SQL text. It must be written in the script (a text literal or a const): values go in '?' placeholders and are passed separately, so they can never change the query.

### Database

An SQL database (SQLite or MySQL). Queries run in the background and call back on the server thread.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `execute(sql: Sql)` | `void` | Runs a statement in the background (CREATE TABLE, INSERT, ...). |
| `execute(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>)` | `void` | Runs a statement with values for its '?' placeholders, in the background. |
| `name` | `string` | The database's name. |
| `query(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>, then: function(List<Row>): void)` | `void` | Runs a query in the background, then calls the function with the rows (on the server thread). |
| `query(sql: Sql, then: function(List<Row>): void)` | `void` | Runs a query without parameters in the background, then calls the function with the rows. |
| `queryFirst(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>, then: function(Row?): void)` | `void` | Runs a query in the background, then calls the function with the first row, or null if there is none. |
| `querySync(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>)` | `List<Row>` | Runs a query and waits for the rows. Only allowed off the server thread (inside async { } or an asynchronous event). |
| `update(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>, then: function(int): void)` | `void` | Runs a statement in the background, then calls the function with the number of changed rows (on the server thread). |
| `updateSync(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>)` | `int` | Runs a statement, waits, and returns the number of changed rows. Only allowed off the server thread. |

**`execute(sql: Sql)`** — Errors are reported in the server log with the script location.

```tys-body
let db = Database.sqlite("shop.db")
db.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales (player TEXT, item TEXT, price REAL)")
```

**`execute(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>)`**

```tys-body
let db = Database.sqlite("shop.db")
db.execute("INSERT INTO sales VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [player.uuid, "bread", 2.5])
```

**`query(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>, then: function(List<Row>): void)`** — The function only runs if the script is still loaded.

```tys-body
let db = Database.sqlite("shop.db")
db.query("SELECT item, price FROM sales WHERE player = ?", [player.uuid], rows => {
    for row in rows {
        let item = row.string("item")
        player.send("You bought {item}")
    }
})
```

**`querySync(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>)`**

```tys-body
async {
    let db = Database.sqlite("shop.db")
    let rows = db.querySync("SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM sales", [])
    let total = rows[0].long("total")
    log("sales: {total}")
}
```

**`update(sql: Sql, parameters: List<any?>, then: function(int): void)`**

```tys-body
let db = Database.sqlite("shop.db")
db.update("DELETE FROM sales WHERE player = ?", [player.uuid], count => {
    player.send("Removed {count} sales")
})
```

### Row

One row of a query result; read columns by name.

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bool(column: string)` | `bool?` | A column as a bool (numbers: 0 is false), or null. |
| `columns` | `List<string>` | The column names, in query order. |
| `double(column: string)` | `double?` | A column as a double, or null. |
| `get(column: string)` | `any?` | The value of a column (text, long, double, bool, or null). |
| `instant(column: string)` | `Instant?` | A column holding a time in milliseconds (as saved from an Instant), or null. |
| `int(column: string)` | `int?` | A column as an int, or null. |
| `long(column: string)` | `long?` | A column as a long, or null. |
| `string(column: string)` | `string?` | A column as text, or null. |
| `toString()` | `string` | Text such as '{item: bread, price: 2.5}'. |
| `uuid(column: string)` | `UUID?` | A column holding a UUID (as text), or null. |
